about_the_game:
A saying as old as capitalism itself, the customer is always right! and that is especially true in the new hit game DEEPFRIED IN DEEPSPACE!

In this sci-fi turn based strategy game, you play as a down on their luck human in the midst of a wide galaxy of aliens, and you need a job! Luckily, the space diner The Frying Saucer is always hiring. You get hired pretty easily (they seem desperate) and it's time to get to work!

MEET CRAZY ALIENS

Here you'll be meeting a plethora of eccentric aliens to keep you busy. Each of them are hungry, and you need to fix that! To bad these things never seem to tip...

But don't worry, Da Boss will help you out! As an employee at The Frying Saucer Da Boss will show you the ropes, then hunker down in his office and supervise you like no ones business, how helpful...

EXPLORE

Once you have your orders from one customer out of the MANY colorful individuals lookin for a meal, you'll have to go get the ingredients. You'll be traversing the various storage areas that this restaurant uses for its food (they seem a little big, how does a tiny diner have all this space?), using simple WASD or Analogue controls to explore the depths of 'safe' food storage, finding coolers where the little ingredients are hiding!

BATTLE

These ingredients though, don't they seem a little...alive? and angry? Good thing Space Culinary School taught you all the combat skills you'll need to fight these alien ingredients to get the components to serve up your customers! Once you grab one of the ingredients, use one of your cooking techniques to attack the ingredients and get their health low enough to bring back to the kitchen!

Meet new aliens, take orders, battle ingredients, all of this and MORE in the new hit game, Deepfried in Deepspace!

FEATURES:

  • Retro game feel

  • Classic JRPG mechanics

  • Outstanding pixel AND hand drawn sprites

  • Incredible (and annoying) customers of all different species

  • A helpful (to himself) manager

  • Unique alien food creatures

  • and so much more to come!

short_description: Take orders from alien customers & make some food! First you gotta get the ingredients, & they seem to be a bit more sentient than they are on earth. Once you have your order, go to the back & find the ingredients stored in coolers and beat the crap out of them! Be careful, the food fights back.
